name: Glittering Lights Snare
text:
Some of Brastlewark's youth craft lesser versions of this snare to prank their friends. A creature that enters the square's square is subjected to a rapid series of flashing lights that overstimulate the senses. They must attempt a DC 22 Reflex save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Dazzled for 2 rounds.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 round and then dazzled for 1 minute.
